Nordex Group Careers

Concept and Technology Lead (m/f/d)

Requisition ID: 9224 · Madrid, ES, 28001 · Department: Engineering
Apply now

Your tasks

  • Lead Technological Advancements: Drive Nordex wind-turbine-generator technology and associated systems with technical expertise and people-management skills.
  • Project Leadership: Manage diverse, interdisciplinary teams, provide technical guidance and foster collaboration.
  • Engineering Excellence: Lead and conduct analyses, studies and calculations on key technical aspects.
  • Innovate: Initiate and drive innovation focused on cutting-edge technology.
  • Strategic Advisory: Advise on product strategy, development, risk and stakeholder management.
  • Effective Communication: Document and communicate professionally with all company functions, from shop floor to board level.

Your profile

  • Degree in engineering, applied science or equivalent.
  • Several years of industrial R&D experience, ideally with complex systems.
  • Strong knowledge of engineering analyses, studies and calculations in wind-turbine technology.
  • Flexibility to work across an international and diverse organisation.
  • Excellent communication and leadership; advanced English plus German or Spanish.
  • Hands-on, proactive and decisive personality.
  • Proficiency with MS Office and MS Project.

Why join us?

  • Inclusive environment and opportunities for career growth.
  • Flexible working hours and work-life-balance support.
  • A supportive, collaborative culture.

About the Nordex Group

Nordex has manufactured onshore wind-energy plants for around 40 years. With more than 57 GW installed worldwide, subsidiaries in over 40 markets, production facilities across Europe and the Americas, and more than 10,400 employees, the group works to expand alternative energy worldwide.
